$comment: The Desert City dome kit (tools/content/kit/dome.mjs; docs/CONTENT_PIPELINE.md, "The dome kit"): a dome from parts round one axis. Every part's origin is the dome's centre axis at the foot of the drum and a part is drawn where it stands on that drum (bounds: "within"), so parts placed at one point, each turned by its own step, make the dome: the drum's quarters by quarter turns, a panel by 360° / segments (90°, 60°, 45°, 30°: MapMaker turns props in 15° steps). Arch transitions and whole domes fill their boxes like any piece. Looks: stone, sandstone, plaster, copper (verdigris), blue tile, green tile; the ruins are their own families (their collision differs). All stone: a family has one surface, so the copper look plays as stone too.
